'''Espara Soman''' is a refugee in the [[Two Rivers]] from [[Toman Head]].

==Appearance==
She had been stout before coming to the Two Rivers.

==Activities==
Espara comes to the Two Rivers to deal with herbs and cures. She is sent by [[Faile Aybara]] to the [[Women's Circle]]. She probably became a [[Wisdom|Wisdom's]] apprentice.
